title: nourishing crisp malaysian bresaola wrap
description: post-workout malaysian dish featuring crispy bresaola, fresh leafy greens and steamed vegetables

ingredients.name: steamed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as broccoli, carrots and bell peppers

instructions: steam the rice paper sheets for 10 seconds to make them pliable
spread a sheet of steamed rice paper on a flat surface
place 25g of sliced bresaola in the center of the rice paper
add 1/4 cup of steamed vegetables on top of the bresaola
drizzle 1 teaspoon of sambal chili sauce over the vegetables
sprinkle 1/4 cup of crunchy fried shallots over the vegetables
add a few fresh mint leaves for garnish
fold the bottom half of the rice paper up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap to form a cylinder
repeat with the remaining ingredients to make 4-6 wraps
serve immediately, garnished with additional mint leaves and chili sauce if desired
